name: Temporary/Permanent Residence Status -- Entrepreneurship

requirements.blocker_text: Documents confirming business activities in Armenia (e.g. company registration) are required to justify temporary residence status on the entrepreneurship ground.
requirements.fix_path: Register a business in Armenia and gather supporting documentation.

requirements.blocker_text: A long-term entrepreneurship track record in Armenia can qualify directly for permanent (5-year) residence status rather than only the 1-year temporary status.

sources.title: Migration and Citizenship Service (official e-government portal) -- temporary residence status document requirements for entrepreneurship/business: 'documents confirming the business activities'
Armenian Lawyer -- clarifies that long-term entrepreneurship can qualify directly for permanent (5-year) residence status, not just the 1-year temporary track

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). STATUS: DRAFT -- no minimum investment/capital figure was found for this ground on any source reviewed (unlike golden-visa-style thresholds in other countries built in this dataset); the tier-1 page confirms only that 'documents confirming business activities' are required, without a numeric floor, disclosed here as a genuine absence rather than an unresearched gap. The permanent-residence entrepreneurship track is sourced only to a tier-3 legal guide since the tier-1 pages reviewed did not distinguish grounds by residence-status tier as clearly as this file implies. Armenia does not appear to have a separate 'freelancer'/self-employed (work_independent) visa distinct from this entrepreneurship ground -- a self-employed individual would register a business and apply on this same basis, so no separate work_independent file was created for Armenia.
